ICE agents shoot man in New York City with child present

Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents shot a man in New York City while a 5-year-old child was present in the vehicle, according to Mayor Eric Adams. The incident occurred in Marble Hill. The mayor has vowed action and called for ICE to be withdrawn from the city, stating "We want them out." He has also contacted President Trump regarding the matter. The identity of the man shot has been reported as Oscar Belgal.
